hero.headline: The whole of Manas 2026, in your pocket
hero.sub: The full timetable for every stage, a live NOW view and Apple Watch widgets, so you always know when each act starts.

showcase.featuresHeading: Everything you need on the ground

timetable.title: A timetable drawn to scale
timetable.body: Every stage gets its own column and the day is laid out to scale — at a glance you see the overlaps, the gaps, and how much time you have between two acts.

now.title: Playing now, and up next
now.body: The “Now” view shows what’s playing right now and what’s coming up on each stage, with a live marker on whatever is running — the whole festival’s pulse on one screen. Before the gates open it counts the days, hours and minutes down to the start.

settings.title: Make it your own
settings.body: Drag the stages into the order you actually walk the festival, and hide the ones you’re not following. Switch between Hungarian and English with a single tap, set the text size — and every preference stays on your device, with no account and no cloud.

field.title: Built for the field
field.body: After the first load the whole programme lives on your device, so it keeps working when the signal drops in a crowd. If you allow it, your location — only ever on your phone — highlights the stage nearest you, and every time is shown in Budapest time.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.body: After the first load the whole schedule stays on your device — it keeps working even with a weak signal in a crowd.

location.title: The nearest stage
location.body: If you allow it, your location — only ever on your phone — highlights the stage nearest you.

language.title: Hungarian and English
language.body: A one-tap language switch, and every time shown in Budapest time.

watch.title: It’s right there on your wrist
watch.body: The whole programme in a built-in watchOS app: one stage at a time, no grid and no fuss — just as much as you want to take in with a single glance.
watch.swipeBody: Swipe up and down to move through the acts, left and right to change stage — always anchored to the same moment in time, so browsing never drifts away from now.
watch.widgetBody: Raise your wrist and the Smart Stack already shows what’s on. Pin one per stage, add them all, and turn the crown to page between them — plus watch-face complications, so a glance really is all it takes.

cta.title: Take the whole programme with you
cta.body: Download it free and every stage of Manas 2026 is in your pocket and on your wrist — offline, too.

footer.unofficial: Unofficial, fan-made app — not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by the Manas festival or its organizers. “MANAS 2026” is used only to indicate which festival this guide is for.
